searchText: I am trying to build this project for over 5 years…. Pls someone help 🥹 This server is for Ethereum R&D, not for funding or discussion of how to get funding. Ok so technical question, what would the most effective way to integrate distributed validators on a decentralised financial infrastructure, payment’s networks (machine PoS and ATMs) can it be done and how? How does the initiative align with community values? What would it’s impact be if implemented? If this could be answered I might be able to figure out the rest 🙏 If you can please share link to another server or guide me where to go for funding assistance Ideally you don't. It is a damaging to the security of the network for the people who are taking on validator risk to be anyone other than those deciding which algorithm to run.
